definitions: Used to express that one was unaware of a significant future event or circumstance at a particular past moment.
An introductory phrase indicating a past lack of awareness about subsequent important developments.
examples: I thought it was just a casual meeting, little did I know it would change my life.
We set off on our journey, little did I know what adventures awaited us.
She smiled at me, little did I know it would be the last time I saw her.
